data.long_meaning: Avhni is derived from the Sanskrit word 'avhan', which means 'desirable'. It is also associated with 'avhana', meaning 'wish-fulfilling'. In Hindu mythology, Avhni is the name of a goddess who is believed to grant the desires of her devotees. The name Avhni carries the meaning “Desirable, Wish Fulfilling” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avhni usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, wish fulfilling and live with faith, good character and purpose.
